notes.title: Now available on mobile devices!
notes.notes:
Wish you could take young Nick of Nick Hall everywhere you go? Well too bad, because now you can! The Adventures of Nick & Willikins is now available for Android mobile devices. Along with the new release comes new features designed especially for the small screen.

- A brand new interface for touch screen interactions.
 -A “reveal hot spots” button to help eliminate the dreaded Pixel Hunt!
 -Non cursor based inventory handling!​

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PinheadGames.NickAndWillikins

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32139879/a1c376dfdadbf631a2d56b7be32febc10c8ad64e.png[/img]

notes.title: Need more Nick & Willikins?
notes.notes:
Can't get enough of Willikins the Butler and his spoiled ward Nick?
You're in luck!  You can now continue to follow their absurd adventures by listening to the Official podcast!

Hear the latest episode, 'Keep Calm and Ooh-da-lay" right here:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32139879/a51fd46e72fad6b57b6493de5b5ca9338c055ab1.png[/img]
http://aalgar.com/podcast/nwkcaodl.mp3


Then catch up with the entire back catalog!
http://aalgar.com/sarcasticvoyage/n-plus-s.html

Let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Happy Easter Egg!
notes.notes:
Easter has passed, but there are still easter eggs to find! If you've played THE ADVENTURES OF NICK AND WILLIKINS but you haven't found the Narrator's Booth, you haven't seen the entire game! This is the biggest of several easter eggs we've scattered throughout Nick Hall. See if you can find it!

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32139879/3e2394057a8a05f439ca4d3c6b3ffac602954bb1.png[/img]
